hypotheses: A learned pairwise energy can produce some valid held-out miniature Sudoku completions under a fixed search budget.
A low scheduling penalty can produce invalid candidates that independent requirements checks reject.
Only explicitly requested authorized COMMIT in the disposable test owner changes its protected state.

scheduling.success_metric: independent validity and optimality on feasible cases
scheduling.unsatisfiable_metric: explicit reference UNSAT versus invalid candidates; do not count missing answers as valid schedules

claims_excluded: official Sudoku-Extreme or Maze-Unique reproduction from portable probes
GPU speedup, FLOP comparison or joule measurement
native ARCHi, Unity, installed application or local model validation
cross-process atomicity, durable replay protection or tamper-proof audit
evidence_rules: Preserve PASS, FAIL, SKIPPED, ERROR and ABSTAIN separately from COMMIT, REJECT, DAMP and ESCALATE.
Record raw inputs, proposals, independent results, seeds, stop reasons and hashes.
Threshold and settings selection must not inspect held-out test outcomes.
Report cold and warm GPU runs only when actually executed.
Save experimental outputs outside tracked source.
